name: Kagami Kaede
source: A very competent wife in both cooking and cleaning, she tends to make her husband's coworkers envious of him with her culinary skills. Kaede herself however is self-conscious of herself, especially of her own body. Because he's been very busy, Kaede hasn't had anything to do and due to her timid nature, is afraid of asking for sex. She relieves her stress and libido with masturbation, but as of lately it has stopped working.
